name: Vend API Merchant
description: Pay-per-call web-data API for AI agents: extract any URL to clean text or markdown, plus web search, link check, geolocation and PDF-to-text, settled on-chain in XNO per call.
notes: A paid per-request web-data API that agents call directly: it serves a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec (12 paths) and an x402 settlement manifest (24 paid resources) so a caller pays per call in Nano with no subscription. Documentation and spec are public and reachable without login. Paid-only, no free tier, which is why free is false.
